source: Two consecutive user-reported Release CLI runs on one Apple Silicon Mac mini; single pair only, no repeated sample spread

identity_graph.command: cargo run --release -p modelbox-cli --features onnx -- bench-overhead examples/relu-input.json 1000 10

onnx_graph.command: cargo run --release -p modelbox-cli --features onnx -- bench-batch examples/relu.onnx examples/relu-input.json 1000 10

descriptive_comparison.interpretation: Identity graph time is not pure scheduler overhead. Difference includes ONNX Runtime wrapping and allocation, not just model kernel time.

warnings: Single paired observation, not statistically robust.
Pure Identity graph preserves original negative tensor value, so its aggregate checksum is 4000 versus 5000 after Relu.
Only a three-float synthetic Relu fixture; finite batch cannot be extrapolated to vision workload or continuous stream.
Repeated paired bench-compare measurements and hardware subtype have not yet been supplied.
